card.title: Test the Impossible Claim
card.instruction: Get someone else to take the first practical step that could prove the bizarre claim true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There's an invisible bridge across this ditch. Tap for it with your umbrella before I cross.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yours extends. You can test it without leaving the bank.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll probe. But a surface isn't proof it'll hold you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Slide your picnic basket onto it first. Leave my lunch inside; I want a convincing weight.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 asks B to probe before A crosses; A3 uses extension reach and A5 requests a basket test after surface detection proves insufficient.

heightening.evidence: B4 qualifies what probing proves; A5 adds a more consequential test while keeping B as first actor.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 leaving lunch in the basket earns its concrete insistence from B4 the need for meaningful weight.
